text:
sam_runtime: Heads up: nightly perf CI flagged a regression on small-batch profile. p95 token latency +35% vs baseline. Alert from perf-bot. Tagging @dena_oncall @tara_sre @miguel. Reproducer link: https://ci.internal/runs/2912345678. Logs attached.

perf-bot: perf-bot: nightly-run 2912345678: p95 320ms (baseline 237ms) — deviation +35% — created alert #PRF-8421

dena_oncall: On it. Can someone grab a flamegraph from the failing run? If not possible, grab the top CPU traces from the container.

miguel: I pulled the run, starting a quick comparison. Noticed higher time in kv-cache deserialize step. Dumping profile now.

sam_runtime: thx. Also the nightly used the new kernel scheduler flag rollout on canary nodes—could that be related? @tara_sre any idea?

tara_sre: We rolled out `sched_latency_reduction=1` to a subset yesterday evening. We limited to canary label but maybe CI routed there. I'll check routing.

miguel: Profile snippet (top stacks):
```
0. kv_cache::deserialize (45%)
1. runtime::attention_kernels (18%)
2. rust_alloc::alloc (12%)
3. syscalls (10%)
```
Also seeing frequent small memcpy spikes.

dena_oncall: Can you reproduce with the nightly CI benchmark locally? Command:
`./bench/run_small_batch.sh --seed=42 --profile`

miguel: Reproduced locally (same commit). Running with `--trace` now, uploading flamegraph: https://artifacts.internal/fg/2912345678.html

sam_runtime: Flamegraph shows deep stack in deserialize + repeated lock contention on cache map. Maybe a change in cache shard count? Which commit touched kv cache?

miguel: PR #4251 changed default shard_count from 16 to 8 to reduce memory. That could increase lock contention.

tara_sre: :eyes: If that's the cause we should revert config for nightly CI. I can patch runtime-config map on CI agent to force shard_count=16 for nightly. Want me to do that?

dena_oncall: Do it. Also add a temporary canary to skip the new kernel flag for CI nodes. If latency improves we can confirm two changes combined.

tara_sre: Pushing config now. Will restart the nightly job. ETA ~3m.

ci-bot: ci-bot: triggered retry for job 2912345678 with forced config override. Job queued.

miguel: I'm running a micro-benchmark to confirm. If we've got lock contention, the p95 should drop back near baseline.

sam_runtime: Update in 10. If this resolves, schedule a rollback of PR #4251 and open a follow-up to test shard scaling.

dena_oncall: Also add an automated regression check in the nightly dashboard comparing p95 token latency per component to catch this earlier.

miguel: Retry job finished: p95 240ms, baseline 237ms. Looks much closer. Flamegraph now shows kv deserialize down to 20%.

sam_runtime: :thumbsup: Good signal. Confirming causal link => revert PR #4251 for now. I'll open the revert PR and tag @miguel for follow-up benchmarking.

sam_runtime: Revert PR opened: https://repo.internal/pulls/4260 — removing change to default shard_count. We'll add a ticket to design a dynamic shard strategy and perf test matrices.

dena_oncall: Thanks everyone. I'll close alert PRF-8421 after revert merges and monitor tomorrow's run.

perf-bot: perf-bot: alert PRF-8421 auto-acked after job improvement.
